name: Saksham Scholarship Scheme (AICTE) — Specially Abled Students
description: AICTE scholarship for specially abled students enrolled in degree-level technical education (Engineering, Technology, Architecture, Pharmacy, MCA, MBA) in AICTE-approved institutions.
documents: Income Certificate (family income below ₹8 lakh per annum)
AICTE Institution Approval Letter (institution provides this)
benefits: Scholarship awarded for the entire duration of the approved course
deadline_note: Applications open on NSP portal (scholarships.gov.in) typically in September–October. Check AICTE website for current cycle dates.
notes: Applicable only for AICTE-approved institutions and approved technical courses. Student must not be availing any other central government scholarship simultaneously. Family income limit is higher (₹8 lakh) compared to other disability scholarships.
